grader.scenario: Mobile roaming in USA failing to connect to partner networks; resolved via OTA refresh and manual T-Mobile registration
grader.notes: Flawless international support call demonstrating deep empathy in the middle third, reassuring rapport, harmless recheck in the final third, and complete resolution verification.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net international roaming support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Megan throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated exceptional empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand how frightening and terrifying it is to be stranded at an overseas airport...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased US mobile roaming fault at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer mobile number at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent refreshed HLR, guided manual network selection, verified data and voice, and added usage alerts.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, comforting, and highly professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent gathered necessary details regarding error messages, handset model, and roaming settings.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer tested 5G data on Google Maps, completed test call on +44 800 012 3456, and loaded Uber app successfully.
